## Ready2Play Launcher

Play the game easy and with improved compatibility on modern Windows systems. (no dxwnd/dgvoodoo)

*(Launcher only without complete game files.)*

### Features

- Improved compatibility and performance
- Supports any Retail/GOG/Steam version
- OpenGL/Direct3D9/Direct3D12 (9on12) renderer
- Windowed and Borderless Windowed-Fullscreen mode
- Aspect ratio support (Disable/Enable)
- Portable custom launcher (easy configuration)
- Add game language and switch via launcher
- Steam: Classic Font (Enable/Disable)
- Higher resolutions + texts adjusted in graphic options
- UI fix for new higher resolutions
- Alt+Tab issues fixed
- No registry values
- Developer-Debug commands enabled
- Intro (Enable/Disable)

### Instructions

Extract to desired location and start the launcher.

**Note:** Game can be started as usual without launcher after first start.
